create_image_path_dataset_from_folder: create an ImagePathDataset instance from an image folder directory with subdirectories for each target class
create_image_path_dataset_from_files: create an ImagePathDataset instance from a list of image file paths for inference without targets
build_dataset_from_config: build an ImagePathDataset from a config dictionary using the from_config class method
check_torchvision_imagefolder_structure: check if an image folder follows the torchvision ImageFolder subdirectory structure
load_dataset_with_transforms: load an image dataset that applies TupleToMapTransform to map samples to input and target keys
